check.description: Standing query, zero violations expected: every successful decrypt of a customer key in the last three days was by a principal that key's declared model names. params.query: SELECT r.uid AS key, actor.user.type AS actor_type, coalesce(actor.user.name, '') AS actor, count(*) AS events FROM normalized_events CROSS JOIN UNNEST(resources) AS t(r) WHERE source='aws' AND dt >= date_format(date_add('day', -2, current_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AND api.service.name = 'kms.amazonaws.com' AND api.operation = 'Decrypt' AND status = 'Success' AND r.type = 'AWS::KMS::Key' GROUP BY 1,2,3
